# Uptrue

> Uptrue is a SaaS uptime and infrastructure monitoring platform for web agencies and development teams. It monitors websites, APIs, SSL certificates, DNS records, domains, ports, keywords, and competitors — alerting teams instantly via email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, or webhook when something goes wrong. Built in India, GDPR compliant, EU data storage.

Uptrue is built and operated by Crozent Techlabs Private Limited, B-59, B-Block, Chipyana, Noida – 201009, Uttar Pradesh, India. The platform runs on Vercel with data stored in Supabase (Frankfurt, EU). All plans are subscription-based with no lock-in. A free plan is available with no credit card required.

## Product

- [Uptime Monitoring](https://uptrue.io/#features): HTTP/HTTPS monitoring with check intervals from 30 seconds. Two-confirmation detection across regions eliminates false alarms.
- [10 Monitor Types](https://uptrue.io/#features): HTTP uptime, SSL certificate expiry, domain expiry, DNS record changes, keyword presence/absence on any page, port availability, ICMP ping, API endpoint validation, heartbeat (cron job monitoring), and competitor price/stock tracking.
- [Multi-Channel Alerts](https://uptrue.io/#features): Email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, and HMAC-signed webhooks. Alert on down, recovery, SSL expiry, DNS change, keyword match.
- [Public Status Pages](https://uptrue.io/status): Branded status pages that update in real time when incidents occur. Visitors can subscribe to email notifications.
- [AI Executive Reports](https://uptrue.io/#features): Weekly plain-language summaries of uptime trends and incident patterns, generated by Claude AI. Available on Builder plan and above.
- [Competitor Tracking](https://uptrue.io/#features): Monitor competitor prices and product availability on any ecommerce website. Alerts on price drops or stock changes.

## Free Tools

- [AI SEO Checker](https://uptrue.io/tools/ai-seo-checker): Score any website's AI search readiness across crawler access, content signals, trust & authority, and technical/schema. Produces a 0–100 AI Readiness Score. No signup required.
- [SSL Checker & Score](https://uptrue.io/score): Instant SSL certificate check — expiry date, grade, issuer, and chain validity for any domain.
- [Public Uptime Tracker](https://uptrue.io/tracker): Live uptime data for 100+ major platforms including Shopify, GitHub, Stripe, Cloudflare, and more.
- [Uptime Leaderboard](https://uptrue.io/leaderboard): Rankings of websites by uptime reliability score.
- [All Free Tools](https://uptrue.io/tools): Full list of free monitoring and SEO tools.

## AI Visibility (Dashboard)

- [llms.txt Generator](https://uptrue.io/dashboard/ai-visibility): Generate a tailored llms.txt for your website, optimised per AI engine — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Grok, and Exa.
- [AI Citation Monitor](https://uptrue.io/dashboard/ai-visibility): Check whether AI search engines are citing your site for your target keywords.

## Pricing

- Free: £0 — 3 monitors, 10-minute checks, email alerts only
- Lite: £1/month or £10/year — 5 monitors, 1-minute checks, Slack/Teams/Telegram, status pages
- Builder: £15/month — 25 monitors, AI reports, 3 workspaces, 10 team members
- Scale: £39/month — 100 monitors, 30-second checks, full API access, unlimited status pages
- INR pricing available via Razorpay for India (₹99/mo Lite, ₹1,499/mo Builder, ₹3,999/mo Scale)
